angle_en: Complete understanding remains steady even at the moment of departure.

en.intro: Krishna has just explained the full structure of reality, and now he gives Arjuna a final key. Listen to how knowing him in three layers leads to reaching him at death.
en.notice: Listen to the end of the verse. Those with a disciplined mind know me even at the time of death. The verse shows that knowing Krishna in matter, in the gods, and in sacrifice leads to knowing him at death.
en.next: The next chapter begins with Arjuna asking Krishna to define the terms he has just used.
en.meaning: Those who know me together with the physical realm, the radiant powers, and the inner sacrifice know me even at the time of death.

hi.meaning: जो मनुष्य अधिभूत, अधिदैव और अधियज्ञके सहित मुझे जानते हैं, वे युक्तचेता मनुष्य अन्तकालमें भी मुझे ही जानते हैं अर्थात् प्राप्त होते हैं ॥

en.intro: Krishna has just explained the full structure of reality, and now he gives Arjuna a final key. Listen to how knowing him in three layers leads to reaching him at death.
en.body: Those who know me together with the physical realm, the radiant powers, and the inner sacrifice know me even at the time of death. Listen to the end of the verse. Those with a disciplined mind know me even at the time of death. The verse shows that knowing Krishna in matter, in the gods, and in sacrifice leads to knowing him at death. The next chapter begins with Arjuna asking Krishna to define the terms he has just used.

hi.body: जो मनुष्य अधिभूत, अधिदैव और अधियज्ञके सहित मुझे जानते हैं, वे युक्तचेता मनुष्य अन्तकालमें भी मुझे ही जानते हैं अर्थात् प्राप्त होते हैं ॥ आगे अर्जुन कहते हैं।

issues: borrowed: "Arjuna asks Krishna to define the terms he has just used: Brahman, the self, and the divine principle." (The 'next' field in the script presents the content of the NEXT verse (Arjuna's question in Chapter 8) as if it is the content of the current verse (30). The current verse is about knowing Krishna at death, not about Arjuna asking for definitions. This misattributes the next verse's content to the current one.)

borrowed: "अर्जुन उन शब्दों की परिभाषा माँगते हैं जो कृष्ण ने अभी इस्तेमाल किए हैं: ब्रह्म, आत्मा, और दिव्य तत्व।" (The Hindi 'next' field presents the content of the NEXT verse (Arjuna's question in Chapter 8) as if it is the content of the current verse (30). The current verse is about knowing Krishna at death, not about Arjuna asking for definitions. This misattributes the next verse's content to the current one.)

unsupported: "जो उन्हें भौतिक जगत, देवताओं और यज्ञ में जानते हैं, वह ज्ञान अन्त में छूटता नहीं है।" (The source verse (30) and its fixed meaning state that those who know Krishna *in* matter, gods, and sacrifice know *him* at death. The Hindi notice adds an unsupported claim that 'that knowledge is not left behind' (वह ज्ञान अन्त में छूटता नहीं है), which is a subjective interpretation not explicitly stated in the source text.)

unsupported: "सुनिए, मृत्यु के समय उन्हें जानने का क्या अर्थ है।" (The source verse does not ask what it means to know Krishna at the time of death, but rather states that those who know him in these three aspects know him at death. The intro presents a question/explanation ('what it means') that is not in the source.)

contrast_template: "वे मृत्यु के समय भी उन्हें जानते हैं" (The intro states 'वे मृत्यु के समय भी उन्हें जानते हैं' (they know him even at the time of death), but the verse's core promise is 'अर्थात् प्राप्त होते हैं' (meaning they attain/reach him). The intro omits this crucial attainment aspect, altering the meaning of the verse.)
